card.name: Scattered words before names or enzymes
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on small linking words, commas and partial words just before a proper name or an enzyme or drug name.

modes.label: Linking word before a name
modes.description: A preposition, comma or conjunction right before a character or person name in an opera or travel story.
modes.example: she fell in love<< with>> Escamillo, a dashing bull

modes.label: Inside enzyme or drug names
modes.description: The middle of CYP enzyme names, or a linking word before a drug name in interaction text.
modes.example: Vanzacaftor, tezacaftor, and deutivacaftor are C<<YP>>3A substrates.

card.plain: It responds to a mix of small words and name pieces just before a name, with no single clear theme.
